title: Row versions, storage and cleanup
brief: Connect logical updates to physical versions and the work required to reclaim them.
outcomes: Explain old-snapshot visibility without in-place overwrite assumptions
Distinguish reusable space, file shrinkage and write amplification

title: Write-ahead logs and crash recovery
brief: Explain the ordering that makes a committed change recoverable after a crash.
outcomes: Distinguish durable log from flushed data pages
Separate restart recovery from recovery after storage loss
entry: Atomic transactions, row versions and storage pages.

neighbours.RL115: Owns PostgreSQL checkpoints and WAL settings.

title: Backup, restore and reconciliation
brief: Choose and verify a restorable history, then reconcile the valid work excluded by recovery.
outcomes: Match recovery-point and recovery-time needs to a backup chain
Restore and reconcile later or external effects against a closed source history
entry: Crash recovery, history and transaction boundaries.

title: Replicas, lag and read routing
brief: Route reads from the freshness and failure promises each copy can meet.
outcomes: Distinguish received, durable and replayed progress
Design read-your-write routing and account for lag and retention
entry: Commit durability and application request identity.

title: Failover and fencing
brief: Transfer write authority safely while accounting for divergent or missing history.
outcomes: Separate suspicion of failure from authority to write
Fence, promote, reconcile and rejoin a former primary
